info.name: Select Star Metadata bi tables API

params.name: cloud_object_format
params.description: Filter to only return the entities with the specific file format for the cloud objects.

params.name: collections
params.description: A comma separated list of collection guids, for to filter the collection items from

params.name: databases
params.description: A comma separated list of database guids to filter for items within those databases.

params.name: datasources
params.description: A comma separated list of data sources guids to filter for tables.

params.name: dbt_projects_names
params.description: A comma separated list of dbt project names

params.name: dbt_tags
params.description: A comma separated list of tag guids

params.name: dsuser_created_by
params.description: A comma separated list of Data Source Users guids to filter for element creator. Allowed Values include DSUser GUIDs + 'known_users' + 'unknown_users'

params.name: filenames
params.description: A comma separated list of source file names

params.name: folders
params.description: A list of dbt project guids to filter thesetables for. The returned values will be dbt models

params.name: include_counts
params.description: Calculate and include total object counts in the response.

params.name: is_hidden
params.description: A boolean to show hidden objects when true and hide hidden objects when false. Defaults to False.

params.name: last_queried_on
params.description:
Filter objects by last_queried_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/last_queried_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&last_queried_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects last_queried_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.

params.name: new
params.description: A boolean which filters for newest tables in the organization.

params.name: no_business_owner
params.description: A flag that filters out any table that has a business owner.

params.name: no_description
params.description: A flag that filters out any tables with descriptions

params.name: no_downstream_lineage
params.description: A flag that shows only tables with no downstream lineage

params.name: no_popularity
params.description: A flag that filters out any table that has a popularity rating.

params.name: no_tags
params.description: A flag that filters out any tagged tables

params.name: no_technical_owner
params.description: A flag that filters out any table that has a technical owner.

params.name: no_upstream_lineage
params.description: A flag that shows only tables with no upstream lineage

params.name: order
params.description:
Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.

params.name: owners
params.description: A comma separated list of user or team guids to filter for objects within these users as owners (technical or business).

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: popularity
params.description: A comma separated list of popularity ranges (inclusive) can include integers from 1-100 ex) 1-10,90-100 would be the bottom 10 percent and the top 10 percent, respectively. Ranges can overlap.

params.name: schemas
params.description: A comma separated list of schema guids to filter for tables within those schemas.

params.name: search_all
params.description: Search a table with multiple types of params in one go

params.name: search_business_owner
params.description: Search for an asset using business owner name

params.name: search_collections
params.description: Search for an asset using a collection name

params.name: search_description
params.description: Search for an asset using its description

params.name: search_location
params.description: A search term.

params.name: search_name
params.description: Search for tables given a table name (upto data source name)

params.name: search_tag_name
params.description: Search for an asset using a tag name

params.name: search_technical_owner
params.description: Search for an asset using technical owner name

params.name: status_tags
params.description: A comma separated list of tag guids

params.name: tables
params.description: A list of table guids to filter for

params.name: teams
params.description: A comma separated list of team guids to filter for tables owned by users of those teams.

params.name: updated_on
params.description:
Filter objects by updated_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/updated_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&updated_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects updated_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.
